description: Defines the 'codebook_config' structure and related nested structures and enums for configuring Type-I and Type-II codebooks in 3GPP NR specifications, including parameters for antenna ports, codebook modes, and restrictions.

classes.name: ocudu::codebook_config
classes.description: Configuration structure for Type-I and Type-II codebooks, including nested types for single and multi-panel configurations, restrictions, and parameters.

classes.name: ocudu::codebook_config::type1
classes.description: Represents Type-I codebook configuration with nested structures for single and multi-panel options.

classes.name: ocudu::codebook_config::type1::single_panel
classes.description: Configuration for single-panel Type-I codebook, including antenna port restrictions and RI restrictions.

classes.name: ocudu::codebook_config::type1::multi_panel
classes.description: Configuration for multi-panel Type-I codebook, including restriction types and RI restrictions.

classes.name: ocudu::codebook_config::type2
classes.description: Represents Type-II codebook configuration with nested types for specific Type-II configurations.

classes.name: ocudu::codebook_config::type2::typeii
classes.description: Type-II configuration details, including codebook subset restrictions and RI restrictions.

classes.name: ocudu::codebook_config::type2::typeii_port_selection
classes.description: Type-II port selection configuration, including port sampling size and RI restriction.

methods.description: Equality operator for comparing codebook_config and nested structures.
